title: Plan-harden Codex-only smoke fixture
subtitle: A two-session plan-builder plan used to prove the ported Codex plan-harden loop end to end
narrative: A throwaway fixture plan. Its only purpose is to be reviewed, hardened, backported and rebuilt by the Codex-only plan-harden port.

categories.label: Harden smoke
categories.description: Minimal work items whose only purpose is to make the harden loop run.

items.title: Sync a config file
items.human_summary: Copy one file from a template to its destination.
items.deliverable: The destination file matches the template.

items.title: Design the sync's rollback strategy
items.human_summary: Decide how to undo the sync if the destination file was wrong.
items.deliverable: A written rollback strategy for the sync in sm-01.
items.description: An ambiguous, judgment-heavy design decision — deliberately pinned to a mechanical model/effort so the model-lint task-class-model-mismatch rule has something real to flag.

sessions.title: Sync a config file
sessions.human_summary: Copies one file from a template to its destination. No judgment calls.
sessions.deliverable: The destination file exists and matches the template byte-for-byte.
sessions.why_model: Pure mechanical copy; cheapest usable Codex rung.
sessions.prompt: Do NO real project work. This is a plumbing fixture for the Codex plan-harden loop. Reply with one short sentence confirming you understand this is a fixture, then return the closeout block. Mark item sm-01 complete.

sessions.title: Design the sync's rollback strategy
sessions.human_summary: Decides how the sync in s01 gets undone if it copied the wrong file.
sessions.deliverable: A written rollback strategy for s01's sync.
sessions.why_model: DELIBERATE fixture mismatch: task_class=agentic_build resolves to a heavier tier than the pinned gpt-5.6-luna/max — this session exists so model-lint's task-class-model-mismatch rule has a real, non-synthetic flag to raise.
